summary.intent: Land three small feature PRs (#487 versioned-but-not-published note, #490 skip private npm workspace roots, #491 did-you-mean for package names) in the callisto repo: finalize PR bodies and changesets, then investigate a CI failure the user reported on #490.
summary.outcome: PR bodies and titles were applied to all three draft PRs and changesets were revised after a fresh-reader review. The #490 CI failure was diagnosed as a stalled macos-arm64 runner (job cancelled after ~29 minutes with no runner assigned), and the failed jobs on #490 and #487 were re-queued.

repo: Callisto PRs are validated with `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test` and `just workflow-contracts`.
User-facing changes need a changeset file under `.changeset/`, and commits are GPG-signed (`git commit -S`).
The 'Entire Gates' check fails until a reviewer approves, so a red status there does not indicate a code problem.
The 'Release Artifact Preflight (macos-arm64)' job depends on runner availability and can be cancelled while waiting for a machine.
The existing Cargo 'no version' note and the new private-root skip note both print on every command that loads the workspace, and `init` prints them more than once.
The release preview's publish outlook gained an optional `versionedOnly` list; old preview files without it still load and the schema version is unchanged.
Edit distance for the did-you-mean hint is a small local helper, so no new dependency was added; the internal E102 site in toposort has no hint.
workflow: Diagnose a CI failure by comparing the same job across sibling PRs (#487 stalled, #491 passed in under 4 minutes) and checking step and runner data via `gh api .../actions/jobs/<id>`.
Use `gh run rerun <id> --failed` to re-run only the failed jobs instead of the whole workflow.
Delegate PR body writing and implementation to subagents, then use a context-free agent to read changesets as a fresh reader to catch unclear wording.
Worktrees for implementers are kept until the PRs merge so nothing under review is removed.

friction: The macos-arm64 runner stalled for about 29-31 minutes and cancelled the preflight job on #490 and #487, producing red CI unrelated to the code.
Entire Gates shows a failure simply because no reviewer has approved yet, which makes the PR check list look worse than it is.
open_items: Review #487, #490 and #491 (all draft, CI not fully run).
Check the results of the re-run macos-arm64 jobs on #490 and #487 and report if the runner is still stuck.
Consider deduping the skip note (and the existing Cargo 'no version' note) so `init` does not print it multiple times.
Clean up the three implementer worktrees after the PRs merge.
Decide whether to rely on the macos-arm64 preflight job as a merge gate given runner supply problems.
